text_block_list.text:
Эль Кондор Паса! Эль Кондор Паса! Elll
Condooor
Paaaaasssaaa!
text_block_list.name: Комментатор

text_block_list.text:
A flawless 2,400 meters! Look out,
world! The
Phantom Bird has taken off!
text_block_list.name: Комментатор

text_block_list.text: Traaainer! I did it!
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text: I did it! After all this time...
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text: I won the Japan Cup!
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text:
I scoop her up in a big hug and carry her
like a
plane to the winner's circle.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
She's much smaller up in the air than I
imagined,
and yet also larger than life.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Thank you, everyone! Good things come
to those
who wait! And now my biggest
dream has finally
come true!
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text:
I am Эль Кондор Паса! Checkmate,
Twinkle Series!
Next stop, the world!
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text: Wooooo!
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
As cheers ring out, the gaze of the
crowd is drawn
to one spot in particular.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: El...
text_block_list.name: Спешл Уик

text_block_list.text: Spe?
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text:
The unsung hero of the Japan Cup,
Спешл Уик.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Without her growth and drive to win, the
race
wouldn't have been as exciting as it
was.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Ooohhh, a big cheer for my best amiga,
Spe!
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text:
Today was bueno! Superbueno! Is there
something
you want to tell me?
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text:
What is it, I wonder? A word of
congratulations?
Or perhaps you'll swear
revenge?
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text:
I love you no matter what, so say it,
whatever it
is!
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text:
I wanna know your true feelings! Let's
hear it, Spe!
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text:
You what? Want to congratulate me?
Want to
curse me?
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text: I want a rematch!
text_block_list.name: Спешл Уик

text_block_list.text: Qué?!
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text: Qué?!
text_block_list.name: Spectators

text_block_list.text:
Every jaw in the venue, including El
Condor
Pasa's, drops.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Today was so much fun! I want to run
with you
more!
text_block_list.name: Спешл Уик

text_block_list.text:
Which is why I'm asking for a rematch...
at the
Arima Kinen!
text_block_list.name: Спешл Уик

text_block_list.text: Ohhhhh...
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text: Bueno!
text_block_list.name: Trainer

text_block_list.text:
Did you hear that, everyone?! A
challenge! A call
to arms!
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text:
Spe and I are both headed to the Arima
Kinen!
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text: Wooooo!
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Let's do it, Spe! You, me, and Grass
makes three!
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text:
The Arima Kinen is a title match, so it'll
be a
battle royale!
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text: That's right!
text_block_list.name: Спешл Уик

text_block_list.text:
The whirlwind of battle grows even
larger as it
swallows Спешл Уик as
well.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
The Arima Kinen will be a grand battle
of dreams
amongst the three friends.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
